flags.why: The colloquial use means being unreachable by phone, not simply failing to pick up.
This term remains in everyday use and is misleadingly tagged dated, as illustrated by [current usage](https://bnews.vn/cuu-tro-phai-nhanh-kha-thi-co-trong-tam-truc-tiep/347514.html).
Thuốc đỏ refers to mercurochrome (merbromin), not povidone-iodine, as identified in the [government drug list](https://congbao.chinhphu.vn/tai-ve-van-ban-so-23-2014-tt-byt-12180-7722?format=pdf).
flags.fix: mercurochrome (merbromin); a red antiseptic liquid for wounds

flags.why: The example explains the word's historical meaning instead of using it to refer to a crocodile.
flags.fix: Con thuồng luồng há mõm, để lộ hàm răng sắc nhọn. = The crocodile opened its mouth, revealing sharp teeth.

flags.why: The historical tag misleadingly restricts a word still used for modern underlings, including in [contemporary reporting](https://vnexpress.net/biet-thu-noi-trum-ma-tuy-mexico-tu-thu-5043784.html).
flags.fix: Remove the historical tag; gloss: subordinate; underling (under a leader or boss).
